change_proposals.expected_effect: A recorded deterministic cycle can be replayed to an equivalent structured result after volatile timestamps and identifiers are normalized.
change_proposals.falsification: Reject if identical controlled inputs produce materially different normalized behavior or if replay mutates the source state.
change_proposals.hypothesis: Replaying recorded deterministic inputs against an isolated state can reveal unintended behavioral drift.
change_proposals.rollback: Revert the candidate change and restore the previous verified baseline.
change_proposals.selection_rationale: reproducibility was the highest eligible evidence-backed deficit (0.200) after excluding saturated dimensions, process-only adaptation, and externally blocked cognition.
change_proposals.test_plan: Record a controlled cycle fixture, replay it twice, compare normalized outputs, and run the baseline-owned preservation gate.
change_proposals.title: Add deterministic cycle replay checks

change_proposals.expected_effect: Capability claims distinguish implemented, behaviorally verified, and unverified states.
change_proposals.falsification: Reject if capability labels can advance without evidence or if prior evidence is lost.
change_proposals.hypothesis: Connecting self-model capability claims to explicit passing behavioral evidence can reduce unsupported self-description.
change_proposals.rollback: Revert the candidate change and restore the previous verified baseline.
change_proposals.selection_rationale: self_model was the highest eligible evidence-backed deficit (0.100) after excluding saturated dimensions, process-only adaptation, and externally blocked cognition.
change_proposals.test_plan: Attach evidence status to selected capability claims and verify a failed behavior cannot remain labeled verified.
change_proposals.title: Calibrate self-model claims against behavioral checks

change_proposals.expected_effect: An experiment with a concrete evidence contract can close only from matching later evidence; an underspecified stale experiment is retained but marked as needing specification and no longer contributes to resolvable evidence hunger.
change_proposals.falsification: Reject if unrelated evidence closes an experiment, history is deleted, evidence hunger still counts work that cannot be resolved, or any preserved behavior regresses.
change_proposals.hypothesis: Separating evidence-ready experiments from underspecified investigations can prevent stale unresolved work from dominating attention while preserving every historical experiment and its provenance.
change_proposals.rollback: Revert the candidate change and restore the previous verified baseline.
change_proposals.selection_rationale: Stale evidence debt was detected in experiment X000001 after 25 cycles despite later evaluated evidence; this overrides the saturated aggregate learning metric.
change_proposals.test_plan: Construct evidence-ready and underspecified experiments, provide later evaluated prediction evidence, verify only a legitimate match closes, verify stale underspecified work remains preserved with an explicit non-ready status, and run the baseline-owned preservation gate.
change_proposals.title: Resolve stale experiment evidence debt

change_proposals.expected_effect: Underspecified experiments retain their history while recording what contract fields are missing and whether current grounded evidence can supply them; blocked work does not masquerade as executable experimentation.
change_proposals.falsification: Reject if the candidate invents observables or evidence references, hides unresolved backlog, promotes blocked work to evidence-ready, or regresses preserved behavior.
change_proposals.hypothesis: Explicitly tracing each missing observable, evidence source, and resolution rule can distinguish internally resolvable experiment specifications from work blocked on unavailable evidence without inventing facts.
change_proposals.rollback: Revert the candidate change and restore the previous verified baseline.
change_proposals.selection_rationale: Protected system diagnostic SD000004 reported specification_backlog; this direct diagnostic signal takes priority over aggregate metric saturation.
change_proposals.test_plan: Construct experiments with and without grounded resolvable evidence, verify missing contract fields and resolution paths are explicit, verify no evidence reference or executable contract is fabricated, and run the baseline-owned preservation gate.
change_proposals.title: Triage experiment specification backlog

change_proposals.expected_effect: A blocked experiment and its question remain preserved, but uncertainty-driven selection does not return to them until grounded evidence changes their actionability.
change_proposals.falsification: Reject if blocked work is deleted, attention still loops on the blocked question, eligible inquiry is suppressed, or preserved behavior regresses.
change_proposals.hypothesis: If uncertainty-driven inquiry stops reselecting questions whose active experiment is explicitly blocked, attention can move to other unresolved evidence without deleting blocked history.
change_proposals.rollback: Revert the candidate change and restore the previous verified baseline.
change_proposals.selection_rationale: Protected system diagnostic SD000009 reported blocked_attention_loop; this direct diagnostic signal takes priority over aggregate metric saturation.
change_proposals.test_plan: Construct blocked and non-blocked inquiry states, verify blocked questions are skipped while eligible questions remain selectable, verify blocked history is preserved, and run the baseline-owned preservation gate.
change_proposals.title: Redirect inquiry away from blocked experiments
